judgment.rationale: Both are P1 (rank 0) Knowledge Objectives under the same Key Unit Competence 'count, read, write, compare, order, add and subtract whole numbers from 1 to 5', so the grain and statement type match. First: 'Mentally add numbers whose sum does not exceed 5'; second: 'Mentally subtract numbers whose first term does not exceed 5'. Beyond the shared unit and wording (which alone would not suffice), there is pair-specific substantive evidence for a same-rank developmental direction: the two objectives address the same mental-computation modality over the same 1-5 number range, and fluent mental composition of sums within 5 supplies the part-whole/number-bond facts that mental subtraction within 5 decomposes, so proficiency in mental addition to 5 supports success in mental subtraction from a first term up to 5. The unit table also presents the addition objective (row 5, page 26) ahead of the subtraction objective (row 6, page 27), consistent with, though not by itself establishing, this direction.
